title: A muroid-specific DNMT3L G9a-contact state among eutherians and conserved DNMT3A contacts across tetrapods: data and code
description: Versioned data, code, figures, and reproducibility records for a comparative analysis of vertebrate DNMT3L evolution centered on a sampled muroid LFI state at NP105/NP106/NP107, matched partner-side conservation, locus evidence, ancestral reconstruction, and alignment sensitivity.
